title: Solar plants · GEM / TransitionZero · plants
description: The units of energy_plants_gem_tzsam_units grouped for the map, by the rule of energy_plants_gem_locations: one row for the units of one GEM plant that have the same type and GEM base status and lie at one point. In this version every row holds one unit: 18,732 rows from 18,725 GEM plants, 18,730 of them operating, with 84,285 MW. The point of a row is the point GEM gives for the unit. Non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 4.0).

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Key of the row: location_id, type and GEM base status (for example L100000905592-wind-operating). Where the units of the plant lie at more than one point, every row of the plant ends in -p1, -p2 and so on.

fields.name: location_id
fields.description: GEM location ID: GEM's key of the plant.

fields.name: plant_name
fields.description: Name of the plant or project, as GEM gives it.

fields.name: wiki_url
fields.description: Page of the plant on GEM.wiki, with GEM's references.

fields.name: type
fields.description: GEM type of the units in the row.

fields.name: status_group
fields.description: GEM base status of the units in the row.

fields.name: statuses
fields.description: GEM statuses of the units in the row, as GEM gives them, separated by “; ” (for example cancelled; cancelled - inferred 4 y).

fields.name: technologies
fields.description: Technologies of the units in the row, separated by “; ”.

fields.name: capacity_mw
fields.description: Sum of the capacity of the units in the row, in MW.

fields.name: capacity_class
fields.description: Size class of capacity_mw: lt10 (under 10 MW), 10_99 (10 to under 100 MW), 100_999 (100 to under 1,000 MW), ge1000 (1,000 MW and more).

fields.name: n_units
fields.description: Number of units in the row.

fields.name: capacity_ratings
fields.description: Solar only: capacity ratings of the units in the row (MWac, MWp/dc, unknown), separated by “; ”.

fields.name: start_year_min
fields.description: Earliest start year among the units in the row.
fields.null_meaning: GEM gives no start year for the unit.

fields.name: start_year_max
fields.description: Latest start year among the units in the row.
fields.null_meaning: GEM gives no start year for the unit.

fields.name: iso3_gem
fields.description: As for the first unit of the row (see description).

fields.name: iso3_source
fields.description: As for the first unit of the row.

fields.name: iso3_frame
fields.description: As for the first unit of the row; the point of the row is that unit's point.

fields.name: iso3_frame_rule
fields.description: As for the first unit of the row.

fields.name: control_iso3
fields.description: As for the first unit of the row.
fields.null_meaning: The point does not lie in an area of disputed control (true of all rows in this version).

fields.name: subnational_unit
fields.description: States or provinces of the units in the row, separated by “; ”.
fields.null_meaning: GEM names no state or province.

fields.name: location_accuracy
fields.description: As GEM gives it for the first unit of the row: exact or approximate.

fields.name: coord_precision
fields.description: site or approximate, as for the first unit of the row.

fields.name: coord_source
fields.description: gem: the point is GEM's.

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude of the first unit of the row, as GEM gives it.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude of the first unit of the row, as GEM gives it.

fields.name: n_units_dc_link
fields.description: Number of units in the row that carry a data-center flag of GEM.

fields.name: dc_links
fields.description: Data-center flags of those units (captive_dc, dc_ppa), separated by “; ”.
fields.null_meaning: Empty for all rows: no unit carries a data-center flag of GEM.

fields.name: n_units_other_set
fields.description: Number of units of the same GEM plant that are in the other dataset: abf-energync for rows of abf-energy, and abf-energy for rows of abf-energync.

coverage.geography: Solar plants of the world (GEM / TransitionZero)
known_gaps: Only the TZ-SAM records that GEM took into its tracker, with GEM's solar threshold. All rows are 20 MW or less, so on the map they appear only as you zoom in, at the same zoom levels as plants of the same size in energy_plants_gem_locations.
426 rows (2.3%) have a point that GEM gives as approximate.
15 plants have units in both datasets: 17 rows here and 29 in energy_plants_gem_locations (abf-energy), marked by n_units_other_set.
Country, capacity basis, owners and technology: as in energy_plants_gem_tzsam_units.

verification.method: Rows are built by script from the units of energy_plants_gem_tzsam_units only, by the rule of energy_plants_gem_locations. The build stops if the rows do not add up to the 18,732 units or to their capacity by status. A second run gives byte-identical files.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
record_id is present and unique in all 18,732 records.
Records with coord_precision  have no coordinates; every other record has a longitude and a latitude in range.
Every value of iso3_source, iso3_frame, control_iso3 is the ISO 3166 alpha-3 code of a country or territory of the boundaries release.
The fields type, status_group, capacity_class, iso3_frame_rule, location_accuracy, coord_precision, coord_source hold only the values listed in their descriptions.

Recomputed from the published file and equal to the numbers in the texts of this layer: the number of records (18,732); the counts by coord_precision, status_group; the numbers of records and groups with location_id.
Every record has a non-empty wiki_url (reference to the source record).
The published CSV is byte-identical to the file of the data step (same SHA-256).

display.legend_note: Solar plants from TransitionZero's Solar Asset Mapper, as included by GEM. They are not in “Power plants”, because TransitionZero licenses them for non-commercial use only. All are 20 MW or less and appear as you zoom in. 2.3% of the points are approximate, as stated by GEM.

filters.title: Status (GEM)
filters.note: Operating by default; tick more statuses to add them. Shelved and Cancelled include plants that GEM infers to be stalled after two or four years without observed progress.

filters.title: Data-center flags (GEM)
filters.note: Data-center flags are GEM's; the project does not check them.

Power purchase agreement with a data center (flagged by GEM)

popup.text: GEM lists this plant as captive power for a data center: a plant within the facility that typically supplies most of its power to it.
GEM lists this unit as connected to a data center through a power purchase agreement.
“Inferred”: GEM's inference from lack of observed progress, not a report by the owner.
Part of this plant is in the other GEM layer.

extra_files.description: The table of GEM statuses: each of GEM's ten statuses and the GEM base status (status_group) and label that the project assigns to it.
The country table of GEM's own file (sheet Regions, area, and countries): the name of each country or area and its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (iso3_gem).
The territories that GEM lists separately and the boundary frame includes in a country: iso3_gem, the code of the country of the frame (iso3_source) and the reason.
